Free health care is available daily through Sunday, November 9, at San Luis Rey Church Hall in Laredo — and no appointment, ID, or insurance is needed, according to KGNS.

The Laredo Medical Mission is open daily from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. at San Luis Rey Church Hall, 3502 Sanders Ave. Services include medical care, dental care, mental health services, eye care, physical therapy, and other health care services.

About 100 volunteers are involved, including doctors, nurses, and medical students from around the country, as well as volunteer doctors from Mexico, according to KGNS. Preregistration was encouraged, but walk-ins are welcome.

Organizer Dr. Gustavo Gutierrez said the mission is meant to give people access to care regardless of their situation. "We want everyone to feel welcome here, no matter who they are or where they come from," he said, according to KGNS.

The mission runs through Sunday, November 9.

Sources: KGNS.
